source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS Astronomical-Book fragments (4Q208-4Q211; late 3rd c. BCE through late 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness, but a heavy abridgment of a fuller Aramaic original) as fallback. NO continuous Greek witness for chs 72-82.
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention.
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976, Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI, Drawnel 2011, Neugebauer 1985.
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 + Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI + Drawnel 2011 Aramaic Astronomical Book + Black 1985 (Neugebauer appendix) + Charles 1912 + Knibb 1978 + Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012 Hermeneia.
source.citation: Milik 1976; Tigchelaar-García Martínez DJD XXXVI 2000; Drawnel 2011; Black 1985 (with Neugebauer 1985 'The Astronomical Chapters' appendix); Charles 1912 PD; Knibb 1978; Nickelsburg-VanderKam 2012 1 Enoch 2 Hermeneia; VanderKam 1998 Calendars in the DSS.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 73 — THE MOON'S NATURE — opening section on the lunar synodic cycle. **4Q208 ('Astronomical Enocha,' late 3rd c. BCE, the OLDEST Enoch fragment of any kind) is almost exclusively the lunar synodic table material that the Ge'ez compresses or omits.** Where 4Q208 preserves a passage with direct Ge'ez parallel, the Aramaic is primary; most of 4Q208's lunar tabulations have no surviving Ge'ez counterpart (and so do not appear as verses here — Editor will need to decide whether to seed extra-Ge'ez Aramaic material as appendix-paragraphs).

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ሕግ፡ ርእኩ፡ ሕገ፡ ካልዕተ፡ ለብርሃን፡ ዘንዑስ፡ ዘስሙ፡ ወርኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə ḥəg rəʾku ḥəga kāləʿta la-bərhān zanəʿus zasəmu warḫ
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic: 4Q208/4Q209 do not preserve a direct parallel to this incipit; lunar tables begin at v. 4ff in the Aramaic stratum (Drawnel 2011)
verses.notes: **INCIPIT of the lunar section.** 'After this law I saw another law for the lesser light whose name is moon.' The naming of the moon as ZANəʿUS ('the lesser') parallels Gen 1:16 ('the lesser light to rule the night'). Cf. 1 En 78:1 (the explicit names of sun and moon).

verses.text_geez: ወሰፍሐ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሑረቶ፡ በበ፡ ሕገጊሁ፡ ወብርሃኖ፡ ኆለቆ፡ ለመዋዕሊሁ፡ ኵሉ፡
verses.translit: wa-safḥa lotu kwəlo ḥurato baba ḥəgagihu wa-bərhāno ḫolaqo la-mawāʿəlihu kwəlu
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic not preserved at this verse
verses.notes: Uriel showed Enoch the moon's circuit and light-count. The 'showing' = the lunar-day-count tables that follow.

verses.text_geez: ወብርሃኑ፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡ ወበዐቢይ፡ ኆለቅ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ለፀሐይ፡ ይትዌቅሕ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለወርኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-bərhānu sabʿa məsla bərhānā la-ḍaḥay yəkawwən bərhānā la-warḫ wa-ba-ʿabəy ḫolaq yəkawwən bərhānā la-ḍaḥay yətwaḳḳəḥ məlʿta bərhānā la-warḫ
verses.notes: **The sun's light is sevenfold the moon's** — restated from 72:37. The moon's full-light is a fraction of the sun's. Cross-corpus: cf. Isa 30:26.

verses.text_geez: ወቀዳሚ፡ ቀዋሚሁ፡ በምሥራቅ፡ ይወፅእ፡ በዐሥርት፡ ወአርባዕት፡ መዋዕለ፡ ወሶበ፡ ይትዐጻዕ፡ ለወርኅ፡ ይከውን፡ ለክልኤቱ፡ ስብዓት፡ መዋዕል፡ ምሉአ፡ ብርሃና፡
verses.translit: wa-qadāmi qawāmihu ba-məśrāq yəwaḍḍəʾ ba-ʿaśərt wa-ʾarbāʿt mawāʿəla wa-soba yətʿaḍāʿ la-warḫ yəkawwən la-kəlʾētu səbʿāt mawāʿəl məluʾa bərhānā
verses.witness_primary: Aramaic 4Q209 frag 7 col. ii lines 1-5 preserves traces of the 14-day waxing-to-full cycle (Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 pp. 144-146; Drawnel 2011 pp. 230-235); Ge'ez parallel preserves the verse complete
verses.text_aramaic: וקדמי קומה במדנחא יפק ביום ארבעת עשר וכד יסלק לסיהרא יהוה לתרין שבעין יומין מלי נהורהא
verses.notes: **THE 14-DAY WAXING + FULL MOON AT TWO WEEKS.** This is the foundational lunar-month structure. The Aramaic 4Q209 preserves fragmentary parallels — 4Q208/4Q209 together preserve a much fuller tabulation of the 30-day synodic cycle than the Ge'ez has. **The Aramaic stratum tabulates day-by-day visible-light fractions** (e.g., '1/7 of 1/14 visible on day 1'), heavily compressed in the Ge'ez. Editor note: the Aramaic lunar tables in 4Q208 alone go beyond the entire Ge'ez of chs 73-74.

verses.text_geez: ወትበጽሕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ለስብዕት፡ ክፍል፡ አሐደ፡ እምነ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
verses.translit: wa-təbaṣṣəḥ bərhānā lāʿlēhā la-səbʿət kəfl ʾaḥada ʾəmənna bərhānu la-ḍaḥay
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q208 frag 1+ may preserve fractional-light tabulation (Drawnel 2011)
verses.notes: **The moon receives a seventh of the sun's light** — the per-fraction unit by which lunar luminosity is computed. The 7-fold-luminosity ratio (sun:moon) and the 7-fraction division of moonlight together generate the 49-unit tabulation system used in 4Q208.

verses.text_geez: ወበቀዳሚ፡ ዕለታ፡ ይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕ፡ ክፍላት፡ ወትገብእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በቀዳሚ፡ ዕለታ፡ ብርሃና፡ ሰብዐ፡ ምስለ፡ ዐሥር፡ ወአርባዕ፡ ክፍላት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-qadāmi ʿəlatā yəkawwən bərhānā sabʿa məsla ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿ kəflāt wa-təgabbəʾ bərhānā ba-qadāmi ʿəlatā bərhānā sabʿa məsla ʿaśr wa-ʾarbāʿ kəflāt
verses.notes: **Day 1 of lunar month: light = 1/14 × 1/7 (or equivalent fractional formula).** The Ge'ez is corrupted here (Charles 1912 conjectures emendation). This is THE place where the Aramaic 4Q208 stratum is dramatically fuller — the full day-by-day fractional tabulation is one of the major scholarly findings from DJD XXXVI.

verses.text_geez: ወትትባእ፡ ብርሃና፡ በስብዕ፡ ክፍላት፡ ፍጽም፡ ወትበጽሕ፡ ብርሃና፡ ለኬራ፡ ዘምሥራቅ፡ ወትሥረቅ፡ ወትበርህ፡
verses.translit: wa-tətbāʾ bərhānā ba-səbʿ kəflāt fəṣṣəm wa-təbaṣṣəḥ bərhānā la-kērā za-məśrāq wa-təśraq wa-təbarrəh
verses.notes: **The moon rises (təśraq) and shines.** The post-new-moon waxing is described. End of ch 73.

verses.text_geez: ወካዕበ፡ ትትዌቅሕ፡ በበ፡ ዕለታ፡ ብርሃና፡ ወይከውን፡ ብርሃና፡ ድልዋ፡ ለፀሐይ፡
verses.translit: wa-kāʿba tətwaḳḳəḥ baba ʿəlatā bərhānā wa-yəkawwən bərhānā dəlwā la-ḍaḥay
verses.witness_secondary: Aramaic 4Q208 lunar tables preserve fuller parallel material
verses.notes: **The moon's light increases day by day until equal-to-the-sun (i.e. full moon).** Charles 1912 notes the Ge'ez 'equal to the sun' is figurative (full-light state). The 4Q208 Aramaic tabulation would have continued day-by-day through day 30, but the Ge'ez compresses to summary.
